title: Human Colon Tissue Dissociation for Immune Cells
author: Kylie James
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tbfeijn

steps.title: Mince tissue and transfer to PBS
steps.instruction: In a petri dish containing collection media, cut the colon tissue into small pieces with surgical scissors, then transfer the pieces to a 50 ml Falcon tube with 10 ml PBS + HEPES and gently agitate.

steps.title: First enzymatic incubation
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml RPMI + HEPES + EDTA, place on a shaker at ~200 rpm and incubate for 20 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Vortex and wash tissue
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube, aspirate and discard the supernatant, then wash the tissue pieces in a petri dish with >10 ml PBS + HEPES.

steps.title: Second enzymatic digestion
steps.instruction: Using forceps, transfer the washed pieces to a fresh 50 ml Falcon tube containing 8 ml RPMI + HEPES + enzymes (Liberase and DNase as prepared), incubate for 30 min at 37 °C with shaking (~200 rpm).

steps.title: Strain and wash cells
steps.instruction: Vortex the digestion, pass the suspension through a 100 µm yellow cell strainer into a fresh 50 ml tube; use the plunger of a 5 ml syringe to push remaining tissue through the strainer, then wash the strainer with 10 ml 2 % FBS/PBS.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend in Percoll
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate for 10 min at 1 200 rpm, discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 5 ml Percoll P‑40, and transfer to a 15 ml Falcon tube.

steps.title: Underlay with Percoll P‑80
steps.instruction: Using a 1 ml pipette, gently underlay the cell suspension with 3 ml Percoll P‑80.

steps.title: Density gradient centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin the tube for 20 min at 600 × g, 10 °C, with no acceleration and no brake.

steps.title: Collect interface cells
steps.instruction: Using a plastic Pasteur pipette or 1 ml pipette, collect the cells at the interface into a new 15 ml tube, bring the volume to 10 ml with 2 % FBS/PBS, centrifuge for 7 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Stain with antibody cocktail
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of antibody cocktail (prepared in 2 % FBS/PBS, or BD Brilliant Violet Staining Buffer if using >2 BV‑conjugated antibodies) directly to the cells, mix well, and incubate at room temperature for 20 min.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend for FACS
steps.instruction: Transfer the stained cells to a FACS tube, wash with FACS buffer (2 % FBS/PBS) to collect as many cells as possible, bring the volume to 2 ml, centrifuge for 5 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare for sorting
steps.instruction: Aim to sort 50 000 target cells into 500 ml (as written) 2 % FBS/PBS in Eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the following solutions: 200 ml PBS/HEPES (198 ml PBS + 2 ml 10 mM HEPES); 200 ml RPMI/HEPES* (196 ml RPMI + 4 ml 2 % FBS + 2 ml 10 mM HEPES); 120 ml RPMI/HEPES/EDTA (117.6 ml RPMI/HEPES* + 1.2 ml 1 mM DTT + 1.2 ml 5 mM EDTA); 50 ml RPMI/HEPES/Enzymes (44.23 ml RPMI/HEPES* + 1.57 ml DNase (~60 µg/ml) + 4.2 ml Liberase (0.42 mg/ml)); 100 ml 2 % FBS/PBS (FACS buffer: 98 ml PBS + 2 ml FBS); Percoll gradients – P‑100 (30 ml = 27 ml Percoll + 3 ml 10× PBS); P‑40 (30 ml = 12 ml P‑100 + 18 ml RPMI); P‑80 (18 ml = 14.4 ml P‑100 + 5.4 ml PBS). Liberase stock: dilute 2 × 5 mg Liberase in sterile water to 5 mg/ml (use 673 µl per 8 ml digestion cocktail). DNase‑1 stock: dilute to 4 KU/ml (use 252 µl per 8 ml digestion cocktail).

steps.title: Optional repeat digestion
steps.instruction: If additional tissue remains, place it into a petri dish, transfer pieces to a new 50 ml Falcon tube, and repeat steps 4–5 (wash and second enzymatic digestion).

steps.title: Post‑sort cell count
steps.instruction: After sorting, pellet the cells, resuspend in 50 µl PBS, mix 10 µl of this suspension 1:1 with trypan blue, count viable cells (note the sorter may over‑estimate by ~50 %).

steps.title: Prepare cells for 10X
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells at 1 000 cells/µl in PBS and load 5 000 cells onto the 10X Genomics chip.
